question: Should experimental schema version 1 formally reserve a non-empty `CLAW.md` body as executable portable prompt content, replacing its earlier descriptive-text interpretation until a later stable migration boundary?
rationale: This is a user-visible portable-package contract change; code and tests can show the mechanics, but only maintainers can accept the semantic and future migration obligation.

options.title: Accept the experimental contract
options.body: Approve the body-as-prompt meaning while `OPENCLAW_EXPERIMENTAL_CLAWS=1` remains required, and record a versioned migration decision before stable graduation.

options.title: Version before adopting
options.body: Require a new manifest schema version or an explicit compatibility marker before changing existing schema-v1 body semantics.

options.title: Keep prose-only bodies
options.body: Retain the current body meaning and require an explicit managed `SOUL.md` source for prompts.

recommendation.title: Accept the experimental contract
recommendation.body: Approve the body-as-prompt meaning while `OPENCLAW_EXPERIMENTAL_CLAWS=1` remains required, and record a versioned migration decision before stable graduation.

likelyOwner.reason: This author owns the proposed branch and documented the intended experimental contract, although a repository maintainer must make the final product decision.
